--[[
	Color3 function ColorRGB([int]r,[int]g,[int]b)
	accepts R, G and B color integers and returns the ROBLOX-standard Color3 variant.
--]]
function ColorRGB(r,g,b)
	return Color3.new(r/255, g/255, b/255)
end

--[[
	Color3 function ColorHEX([string]hex)
	accepts a color hex in string format (#xxxxxx) and returns the ROBLOX-standard Color3 variant.
--]]
function ColorHEX(hex)
	hex = hex:gsub("#","")
	return ColorRGB(tonumber("0x"..hex:sub(1,2)), tonumber("0x"..hex:sub(3,4)), tonumber("0x"..hex:sub(5,6)))
end

--[[
	Color3 function Color3ValOffset([Color3]OldColor3,[int]ValOffset)
	accepts a Color3 and 'value' offset, and returns the Color3 with this offset applied.
	(In other words; this function makes a Color3 lighter/darker by a specified ValOffset)
--]]
function Color3ValOffset(OldColor3,ValOffset)
	if ValOffset == 0 then
		ValOffset = -55;
	end
	return Color3.new(OldColor3.r + ((ValOffset/255)*OldColor3.r),OldColor3.g + ((ValOffset/255)*OldColor3.g),OldColor3.b + ((ValOffset/255)*OldColor3.b))
end

--[[

void function mGUI.align = 	function(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
void function mGUI.alignXY = function(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
void function mGUI.alignYX = function(Target,AlignY,AlignX,PxOffsetY,PxOffsetX)

aligns the target frame to specified screen positions. Default is XY, the alignYX function swaps coordinates.
valid positions include Top/top,Center/center,Bottom/bottom,Left/left,Middle/middle,Right/right,Up/up,Down/down.

 ARGUMENT			   DESCRIPTION
Instance Target 	> Target frame which will be aligned to specified positions.
String AlignX		> Alignment of position on X axis. can be "Left", "Center" or "Right"
String AlignY		> Alignment of position on Y axis. can be "Top"/"Up", "Center" or "Bottom"/"Down"
Number PxOffsetX	> Pixel offset in X axis. Will be applied without absolute scaling taken into account.
Number PxOffsetY	> Pixel offset in Y axis. Will be applied without absolute scaling taken into account.
																												--]]
function alignFrame(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
	local AbsoluteX = 0
	local AbsoluteY = 0
	local OffsetY = 0
	local OffsetX = 0
	if AlignX == nil or AlignX == "Center" or AlignX == "center" or AlignX == "Middle" or AlignX == "middle" then
		AbsoluteX = 0.5
		OffsetX = -(Target.Size.X.Offset/2) + (PxOffsetX or 0)
	elseif AlignX == "Left" or AlignX == "left" then
		AbsoluteX = 0
		OffsetX = (PxOffsetX or 0)
	elseif AlignX == "Right" or AlignX == "right" then
		AbsoluteX = 1
		OffsetX = -Target.Size.X.Offset + (PxOffsetX or 0)
	end
	if AlignY == nil or AlignY == "Center" or AlignY == "center" or AlignY == "Middle" or AlignY == "middle" then
		AbsoluteY = 0.5
		OffsetY = -(Target.Size.Y.Offset/2) + (PxOffsetY or 0)
	elseif AlignY == "Top" or AlignY == "top" or AlignY == "Up" or AlignY == "up" then
		AbsoluteY = 0
		OffsetY = (PxOffsetY or 0)
	elseif AlignY == "Bottom" or AlignY == "bottom" or AlignY == "Down" or AlignY == "down" then
		AbsoluteY = 1
		OffsetY = -Target.Size.Y.Offset + (PxOffsetY or 0)
	end
	Target.Position = UDim2.new(AbsoluteX,OffsetX,AbsoluteY,OffsetY)
end

mGUI.align = function(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
	alignFrame(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
end

mGUI.alignXY = function(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
	alignFrame(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
end

mGUI.alignYX = function(Target,AlignY,AlignX,PxOffsetY,PxOffsetX)
	alignFrame(Target,AlignX,AlignY,PxOffsetX,PxOffsetY)
end

local ProgressHandler = {
	
	["getMapLength"] = function(Self, PathPositions)
		local Total = 0
		for i = 2, #PathPositions do
			local Dis = (PathPositions[i]-PathPositions[i-1]).magnitude
			Total = Total+Dis
		end
		return Total
	end,
	
	
	
	["getProgressAtPoint"] = function(Self, Vector, PathPositions)
		local Rays = {}
		local P = PathPositions
		for i = 2, #P do
			local Start, End = PathPositions[i-1], PathPositions[i]
			local Line = Ray.new(Start, (End-Start).unit*(Start-End).magnitude)
			Rays[i-1] = Line
		end

		local function checkBounds(Start, End, Check) -- Ugly hack to see if you're in between two points
			local CFrame1 = CFrame.new(Start.X, Start.Y, Start.Z)
			CFrame1 = CFrame.new(CFrame1.p, End)
			local CFrame2 = CFrame.new(End.X, End.Y, End.Z)
			CFrame2 = CFrame.new(CFrame2.p, Start)
			local a1 = CFrame1
			local b1 = Check
			local x1 = (a1:inverse())*b1
			local a2 = CFrame2
			local b2 = Check
			local x2 = (a2:inverse())*b2
			if x1.Z < 0 and x2.Z < 0 then -- in between the lines
				return true
			else -- not in between
				return false
			end
		end
		
		local RayTable = Rays
		local Distances = {}
		for i = 1, #RayTable do
			local MaxDistance = math.min((RayTable[i].Origin-Vector).magnitude, ((RayTable[i].Direction+RayTable[i].Origin)-Vector).magnitude)
			local Default = Ray.new(RayTable[i].Origin, (RayTable[i].Direction).unit):Distance(Vector)
			local inBounds = checkBounds(RayTable[i].Origin, RayTable[i].Origin+RayTable[i].Direction, Vector)
			if inBounds == true then
				Distances[i] = Default
			else
				Distances[i] = MaxDistance
			end
		end
		local Lowest = math.min(unpack(Distances)) -- find out which ray you're closest to
		local LineNum = 0
		for i = 1, #RayTable do
			if Lowest == Ray.new(RayTable[i].Origin, (RayTable[i].Direction).unit):Distance(Vector) then
				LineNum = i -- save which line in the table is closest to the player
			end
		end
		local Total = 0
		if LineNum > 1 then
			for t = 1, LineNum-1 do
				Total = Total+(RayTable[t].Direction).magnitude
			end
		end
		if LineNum == 0 then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local PointOnRay = Ray.new(RayTable[LineNum].Origin, (RayTable[LineNum].Direction).unit):ClosestPoint(Vector)
		Total = Total+(RayTable[LineNum].Origin-PointOnRay).magnitude
		return PointOnRay, Total
	end,
	
	
	
	["getPath"] = function(Self)
		local Map = game.Workspace:findFirstChild("CurrentMap")
		if Map==nil then
			return nil
		else
			local Points = game.workspace.CurrentMap.PathData:GetChildren()
			local PathPoints = {}
			for i = 1, #Points do
				PathPoints[i] = game.workspace.CurrentMap.PathData:findFirstChild(tostring(i)).Position
			end
			return PathPoints
		end
	end
	
}


return ProgressHandler

		local middleclass 		= {
		    _VERSION     		= 'middleclass v3.0.1',
		    _DESCRIPTION 		= 'Object Orientation for Lua'
		}
		
		local function _setClassDictionariesMetatables(aClass)
		   local dict 			= aClass.__instanceDict
		   dict.__index 		= dict
		
			local super 		= aClass.super
		    if super then
		      local superStatic = super.static
		      setmetatable(dict, super.__instanceDict)
		      setmetatable(aClass.static, { __index = function(_,k) return dict[k] or superStatic[k] end })
		    else
		      setmetatable(aClass.static, { __index = function(_,k) return dict[k] end })
		    end
		  end
		
		  local function _setClassMetatable(aClass)
		    setmetatable(aClass, {
		      __tostring 		= function() return "class " .. aClass.name end,
		      __index    		= aClass.static,
		      __newindex 		= aClass.__instanceDict,
		      __call     		= function(self, ...) return self:New(...) end
		    })
		end
		
		local function _createClass(name, super)
		    local aClass 		= { name = name, super = super, static = {}, __mixins = {}, __instanceDict={} }
		    aClass.subclasses 	= setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
		
		    _setClassDictionariesMetatables(aClass)
		    _setClassMetatable(aClass)
		
		    return aClass
		end
		
		local function _createLookupMetamethod(aClass, name)
		    return function(...)
		      local method 		= aClass.super[name]
		      assert(type(method) == 'function', tostring(aClass) .. " doesn't implement metamethod '" .. name .. "'" )
		      return method(...)
		    end
		end
		
		local function _setClassMetamethods(aClass)
		    for _,m in ipairs(aClass.__metamethods) do
		      aClass[m]			= _createLookupMetamethod(aClass, m)
		    end
		end
		
		local function _setDefaultInitializeMethod(aClass, super)
		    aClass.initialize = function(instance, ...)
		      return super.initialize(instance, ...)
		    end
		end
		
		local function _includeMixin(aClass, mixin)
		    assert(type(mixin) =='table', "mixin must be a table")
		    for name,method in pairs(mixin) do
		      if name ~= "included" and name ~= "static" then aClass[name] = method end
		    end
		    if mixin.static then
		      for name,method in pairs(mixin.static) do
		        aClass.static[name] = method
		      end
		    end
		    if type(mixin.included)=="function" then 
		    	mixin:included(aClass)
		    end
		    aClass.__mixins[mixin] = true
		end
		
		local Object = _createClass("Object", nil)
		
		Object.static.__metamethods = { '__add', '__call', '__concat', '__div', '__ipairs', '__le',  '__len', '__lt', '__mod', '__mul', '__pairs', '__pow', '__sub', '__tostring', '__unm'}
		
		function Object.static:allocate()
		    assert(type(self) == 'table', "Make sure that you are using 'Class:allocate' instead of 'Class.allocate'")
		    return setmetatable({class = self}, self.__instanceDict)
		end
		
		function Object.static:New(...)
		    local instance = self:allocate()
		    instance:initialize(...)
		    return instance
		end
		
		function Object.static:subclass(name)
		    assert(type(self) == 'table', "Make sure that you are using 'Class:subclass' instead of 'Class.subclass'")
		    assert(type(name) == "string", "You must provide a name(string) for your class")
		
		    local subclass = _createClass(name, self)
		    _setClassMetamethods(subclass)
		    _setDefaultInitializeMethod(subclass, self)
		    self.subclasses[subclass] = true
		    self:subclassed(subclass)
		
		    return subclass
		end
		
		function Object.static:subclassed(other) end
		
		function Object.static:isSubclassOf(other)
		    return type(other) == 'table' and type(self) == 'table' and type(self.super) == 'table' and (self.super == other or type(self.super.isSubclassOf) == 'function' and
			self.super:isSubclassOf(other))
		end
		
		function Object.static:include( ... )
		    assert(type(self) == 'table', "Make sure you that you are using 'Class:include' instead of 'Class.include'")
		    for _,mixin in ipairs({...}) do 
		    	_includeMixin(self, mixin) 
		   	end
		    return self
		end
		
		function Object.static:includes(mixin)
		    return type(mixin) == 'table' and type(self) == 'table' and type(self.__mixins) == 'table' and (self.__mixins[mixin] or type(self.super) == 'table' and type(self.super.includes) == 'function' and self.super:includes(mixin))
		end
		
		function Object:initialize() end
		
		function Object:__tostring() 
			return "instance of " .. tostring(self.class) 
		end
		
		function Object:isInstanceOf(aClass)
		   return type(self) == 'table' and type(self.class) == 'table' and type(aClass) == 'table' and (aClass == self.class or type(aClass.isSubclassOf) == 'function' and self.class:isSubclassOf(aClass))
		end
	
		function middleclass.class(name, super, ...)
		  super = super or Object
		  return super:subclass(name, ...)
		end
		
		middleclass.Object = Object
		
		setmetatable(middleclass, { __call = function(_, ...) return middleclass.class(...) end })
		
		return middleclass

	local P = game.Players:GetPlayers()
	for i = 1, #P do

		end
	end
	return List

function NewPart()
	local Prt = Instance.new("Part")
	Prt.Transparency = .3
	Prt.Anchored = true
	Prt.CanCollide = false
	Prt.TopSurface = "Smooth"
	Prt.BottomSurface = "Smooth"
	Prt.FormFactor = "Custom"
	Prt.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Medium stone grey")
	return Prt
end

local function ReOrderTable(tab)
	local new = {}
	
	for _, v in next, tab do
		new[#new + 1] = v
	end
	
	return new
end
